1. Section plane on Y = +36.5 passes through the +Y pair of stack rods; rods, screws and standoffs are not sectioned.
2. Boards: E02 battery, E01 EPS, E03 OBC in the lower bay; E04 COM in the upper bay with the payload bay above (Z 215-318).
3. Bonding: rails, frames, spacers and the board ground rings form the chassis ground; one point to power ground on E01.
